cloud-gray.$description: Cloud Gray — Page canvas, card borders, hairline dividers, image frames — the dominant neutral that defines the surface field

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Primary text, filled action buttons, hero overlays, footer — the anchor that gives the minimal palette its weight

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Card surfaces, content backgrounds, button text on dark fills

sand-beige.$description: Sand Beige — Soft section background, alternate surface, and quiet card fill.

graphite.$description: Graphite — Muted body text, secondary links, helper text — recedes so Obsidian can lead

speedrun-gradient.$description: Speedrun Gradient — Supporting palette color for small decorative accents when the core palette needs contrast. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color; Decorative radial gradient bloom — used as ambient atmosphere behind text, never as a functional fill

messinasans.$description: Display, headings, body, navigation — the only voice. Weight 900 at display sizes with -0.074em tracking creates a condensed, almost stenciled confidence. The 243px hero size is anti-scale: most sites stop at 72–96px, this pushes to nearly a quarter of the viewport height for maximum editorial impact

messinasanscondensed.$description: Uppercase eyebrow labels, category tags, button text — the counter-rhythm to messinaSans. Where the display font compresses inward, this one expands outward with +0.06em tracking, creating a typographic call-and-response where labels feel like they're announcing the headline

messina-sans.$description: Messina Sans — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
